assistant.report.title: Incident report
assistant.report.notice: Possible explanations only. Rank shows presentation order; cause remains unproven. Suggested reads need a separate explicit request.
assistant.report.loading: Checking current access and reading the report…
assistant.report.unavailable: The report is unavailable. No new investigation was started.
assistant.report.none: These bounded observations support no qualified explanation.
assistant.report.health: A resource health problem may contribute
assistant.report.gap.limited: Some observations are stale or partial.
assistant.report.gap.limits: Matching positive resource limits are missing.
assistant.report.gap.reset: A restart counter reset breaks comparison across its prior lifetime.
assistant.report.gap.window: An observation predates the selected window.
assistant.report.read.metrics: Review the selected metric window and matching limits.
assistant.title: Smart Assistant
assistant.description: Explain this resource using a bounded snapshot of available evidence.
assistant.privacy: Conversation text stays in browser and local-service memory. Closing this view, changing scope or session, or expiry clears the view. Check the cited evidence before acting.
assistant.investigationScope: Read inventory, health, metrics, events and in-scope relationships once. Missing data stays visible. No changes are made.
assistant.logConsent: Include policy-filtered local logs for this run (5 or 15 minutes only). Changing this choice clears the view.
assistant.question: Question about this resource
assistant.citationUnavailable: Evidence is unavailable or its access changed. No navigation was made.
assistant.questionLimit: At most 8 KiB per question, eight submitted turns and 30 minutes per view. Do not enter credentials.
assistant.state.idle: Choose a window and enter a question. Send it explicitly to start a run.
assistant.state.unavailable: The assistant or evidence is unavailable, or access changed. Ask the operator to check availability before entering a new question.
assistant.state.volatile_lost: The local response is no longer available. Enter a new question to start again.
assistant.state.needs_refresh: Live status ended or could not be verified. Read the current result explicitly; the question will not be resent.
assistant.state.admission_unknown: The submission result is unknown. Retry explicitly with the same request, or stop and clear this view.
assistant.state.cancelling: Browser text cleared. Waiting for cancellation acknowledgement…
assistant.state.already_terminal: The run had already ended. Browser text cleared.
assistant.state.cancel_unknown: Browser text cleared. Server cancellation is unconfirmed; work may continue until its limit.
assistant.state.expired: This view expired. Its text was cleared. Re-enter a question to start again.
assistant.state.limit: Eight submitted turns reached. Start a new conversation to continue.
assistant.state.invalid_question: Enter a nonempty question within 8 KiB using valid text. No new request was sent.
